snippets.label: Next.js
snippets.code:
# 1. Install the SDK
npm install @bigbertha/sdk

# 2. Environment (.env.local and your host). The upload key is secret: CI only.
NEXT_PUBLIC_BERTHA_KEY="7711956ee7f8d6da7eaf0c97d0ea2a1d"
NEXT_PUBLIC_BERTHA_URL="https://bertha.sundial.dev"
BERTHA_UPLOAD_KEY="bu_d1a2ae0d79c0fae7ad6d8f7e"

# 3. instrumentation.ts
export { register, onRequestError } from "@bigbertha/sdk/next"

# 4. instrumentation-client.ts
export { onRouterTransitionStart } from "@bigbertha/sdk/next/client"

# 5. next.config.ts: releases and source maps
import { withBertha } from "@bigbertha/sdk/next/config"
export default withBertha(nextConfig)

# After each deploy, in CI
npx bertha deploy --env production

# Optional: traces, so an error shows what its request did across your services
npm install @vercel/otel
# instrumentation.ts, in place of step 3
import { OTLPHttpProtoTraceExporter, registerOTel } from "@vercel/otel"
import { otlp, register as bertha } from "@bigbertha/sdk/next"
export { onRequestError } from "@bigbertha/sdk/next"
export function register() {
  registerOTel({ traceExporter: new OTLPHttpProtoTraceExporter(otlp()) })
  return bertha()
}

snippets.label: Rust
snippets.code:
# 1. Install the SDK
cargo add bigbertha --features tracing,tower,anyhow

# 2. Environment. The upload key is secret: CI only.
BERTHA_KEY="7711956ee7f8d6da7eaf0c97d0ea2a1d"
BERTHA_URL="https://bertha.sundial.dev"
BERTHA_UPLOAD_KEY="bu_d1a2ae0d79c0fae7ad6d8f7e"
# So anyhow errors carry where they came from
RUST_LIB_BACKTRACE=1

# 3. main.rs, first thing. Keep the guard until main returns.
let _bertha = bigbertha::init(bigbertha::options!());
tracing_subscriber::registry().with(fmt::layer()).with(bigbertha::tracing::layer()).init();

# 4. Your router: the request on every error, and panics as 500s
let app = Router::new().route("/", get(home)).layer(bigbertha::tower::layer());

# 5. Cargo.toml: file and line numbers in release builds
[profile.release]
debug = "line-tables-only"

# After each deploy, in CI
npx @bigbertha/sdk deploy --env production

briefs.p-kiln:
Next.js 15 shop on Vercel, Shopify Storefront API behind it. Repo: sundial/kiln.

- The basket API answers **204** for an empty basket, not `{ lines: [] }`.
- `ResizeObserver loop` errors are browser noise. Leave them ignored.
- Deploys go out from `main` several times a day; `-rc` releases are staging.
briefs.p-moss:
Astro site on Netlify for the wedding venue. Enquiries post to a Netlify function that emails the office.

Safari cancels prefetches on navigation and reports them as `Failed to fetch`. Check the stack for `prefetch` before anything else.

issues.message: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.

triages.found: ResizeObserver reports this when a callback changes layout in the same frame. Browsers recover by themselves; nothing visible goes wrong.
`basket.lines` is undefined when the basket API answers 204 for an empty basket. `CartDrawer` maps over it before the empty state renders.
Only on Safari, only after a discount code is removed. Couldn't reproduce locally.
triages.tried: Removing codes in Safari 17 and 18 with an empty and a full basket. Both fine.

activity.body:
Cause: `CartDrawer` maps `cart.items` before the refetch settles. The cart endpoint returns `items: undefined` for an emptied basket, not `[]` (https://github.com/sundial-dev/kiln-and-clay/blob/a41c9e2/api/cart.ts#L88).

Fix: default to `[]` in the endpoint and guard the drawer, in https://github.com/sundial-dev/kiln-and-clay/pull/212 on Priya's gift-wrap branch (a41c9e2). Not related to KILN-K, which fires on the same page. Same drawer as http://localhost:4321/issues/i-hydration. Resolve in the next release once it merges.

Happens when the basket is emptied from another tab while the drawer is open. `items` comes back `undefined` from the cart endpoint instead of `[]`.

Fix is in progress — see the gift-wrap branch.

issues.message: Hydration failed because the server rendered HTML didn't match the client. As a result this tree will be regenerated on the client.

triages.found: The opening hours banner renders `new Date()` on the server in UTC and on the client in local time.
Visitors on a tab opened before a deploy ask for chunks the new build deleted.
triages.fix: Reload once on `ChunkLoadError` instead of failing the route. PR #142.

issues.message: Failed to execute 'setItem' on 'Storage': Setting the value of 'kc-basket-v2' exceeded the quota.
request to https://practice-sync.internal/slots?practice=whitby&from=2026-10-13 failed, reason: connect ETIMEDOUT 10.4.2.17:443

triages.found: practice-sync is the practice system's own server, and it drops connections during its nightly backup (02:00 to 02:40).
triages.tried: Retrying with backoff. The backup outlasts any retry worth waiting for.

issues.message: Error: Booking slot 2026-10-14T09:30:00+01:00 with Dr. O'Sullivan-Reyes is no longer available

triages.found: Two tabs can hold the same slot; the second hold rejects and nothing catches it.
triages.fix: Catch the conflict and offer the next free slot. Pushed 5d0c2a9e.

watch.problem: bertha only watches fixes on GitHub repos. Mark it shipped once it's deployed.

issues.message: Cannot destructure property 'id' of 'session.user' as it is undefined.

triages.found: The gallery prefetch runs on hover and Safari cancels it on navigation, which reports as `Failed to fetch`.
triages.tried: Catching the abort in the fetch wrapper. It still reported, because the SDK records the rejection first.
triages.fix: Prefetch through `<link rel=prefetch>` instead of fetch. [moss#88](https://github.com/sundial/moss/pull/88).

issues.message: enquiry.guestCount must be a whole number between 1 and 250 but received "around 120 maybe 140 depending on whether the evening guests are included, will confirm with my partner and her mum this weekend" (field: guests, form: wedding-enquiry-v2, step 3 of 4, locale: en-GB)
Minified React error #418; visit https://react.dev/errors/418?args[]=HTML&args[]= for the full message or use the non-minified dev environment for full errors and additional helpful warnings.
Newsletter archive: 3 issues have no PDF attached (Sept 2019, Advent 2021, Lent 2023)
Invalid harmonic constituent count: expected 37, got 0

triages.found: `formatSowingWindow` gets an empty date for plants with no sowing window set.
triages.fix: Show "No sowing window" when the dates are missing. https://github.com/sundial-dev/allotment-planner/pull/57

issues.message: Invoice run aborted: 3 of 41 invoices failed to render (PDF render timed out after 30000ms)

activity.body: Re-ran by hand. Raised the render timeout to 60s.

triages.found: `measure` runs after the carousel unmounts when the route changes mid-swipe.
triages.fix: Cancel the frame in the effect cleanup. #139

issues.message: Text content does not match server-rendered HTML.

triages.found: `Price` formats with the visitor's locale on the client and en-GB on the server.
